references.text: The preceding verse explains that the Levites shall give a tenth of the tithe they receive as a gift to the Lord, which provides context for how their offering is to be counted.
Confirms that when the Levites give the best part of the tithe, the remainder is to be reckoned for them as the produce from the threshing floor and the winepress.
Also mentions the threshing floor and the winepress in connection with gifts and blessings from the Lord.
Mentions firstfruits of grain and wine that are to be given to the priests, parallel to the images of the threshing floor and the winepress.
Concerns a wave offering from the threshing floor, using the same terminology as for the Levites' gift.
Commands giving the firstfruits of the harvest and the winepress to the Lord, a similar concept with offerings from agricultural produce.
Mentions the threshing floor and the winepress in connection with the Feast of Tabernacles and the Lord's blessings.
